import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

R = {'https://demo.test': 'r1', 'http://a.test': 'r2', 'https://t.test': 'r3'}

def run1(fields, data=None, trailing=None, sid=0, routes=None, events=None):
    ev = events if events is not None else stream(sid, fields, data=data, trailing=trailing)
    return run({'routes': routes if routes is not None else R, 'events': ev})

F = base_fields

# ---- cookie joining at first position, order preserved
f = F(method='POST', path='/c', authority='demo.test', scheme='https',
      extra=[('accept','text/html'), ('cookie','a=1'), ('x-one','1'),
             ('cookie','b=2'), ('cookie','c=3'), ('accept','application/json')])
got = run1(f, data=['0400'])
want = (b'POST /c HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\naccept: text/html\r\n'
        b'cookie: a=1; b=2; c=3\r\nx-one: 1\r\naccept: application/json\r\n'
        b'content-length: 2\r\n\r\n\x04\x00')
check('cookie-join', None,
      [rec(0,'forwarded',commit_at=2,origin='r1',offset=0,length=len(want),
           cache_key=['POST','https','demo.test','/c'])],
      {'r1': want, 'r2': b'', 'r3': b''}, routes=R, events=stream(0, f, data=['0400']))

# ---- content-length omitted, cl lines omitted, te consumed
f = F(method='POST', path='/x', extra=[('content-length','2'), ('te','trailers'),
                                       ('content-length','2')])
got = run1(f, data=['0400'])
want = b'POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 2\r\n\r\n\x04\x00'
check('cl-omitted', None, None, {'r1': want, 'r2': b'', 'r3': b''},
      routes=R, events=stream(0, f, data=['0400']))

# ---- chunked branch with trailers, dedup announcement
f = F(method='POST', path='/x', extra=[('te','trailers')])
tr = [['x-audit-b','2'], ['x-audit-a','1'], ['x-audit-b','3']]
got = run1(f, data=['0400','01'], trailing=tr)
want = (b'POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n'
        b'trailer: x-audit-b, x-audit-a\r\n\r\n'
        b'3\r\n\x04\x00\x01\r\n0\r\nx-audit-b: 2\r\nx-audit-a: 1\r\nx-audit-b: 3\r\n\r\n')
check('chunked-trailers', None, None, {'r1': want, 'r2': b'', 'r3': b''},
      routes=R, events=stream(0, f, data=['0400','01'], trailing=tr))

# ---- chunked with empty content but trailers
got = run1(f, trailing=tr)
want = (b'POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n'
        b'trailer: x-audit-b, x-audit-a\r\n\r\n0\r\n'
        b'x-audit-b: 2\r\nx-audit-a: 1\r\nx-audit-b: 3\r\n\r\n')
check('chunked-empty-body', None, None, {'r1': want, 'r2': b'', 'r3': b''},
      routes=R, events=stream(0, f, trailing=tr))

# ---- chunked, empty content, empty trailers
got = run1(f, trailing=[])
want = (b'POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\n')
check('chunked-empty-trailers', None, None, {'r1': want, 'r2': b'', 'r3': b''},
      routes=R, events=stream(0, f, trailing=[]))

# ---- empty DATA events allowed
f = F(extra=[('te','trailers')])
got = run1(f, data=['','00',''], trailing=[])
want = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\n'
check('empty-data', None, None, {'r1': want, 'r2': b'', 'r3': b''},
      routes=R, events=stream(0, f, data=['','00',''], trailing=[]))

# ---- content-length validation
cases = [
    ([('content-length','0')], [], True),
    ([('content-length','2')], ['0203'], True),
    ([('content-length','02')], ['0203'], True),
    ([('content-length','2, 2')], ['0203'], True),
    ([('content-length','2')], ['0102'], False),
    ([('content-length','')], [], False),
    ([('content-length','2,')], ['0203'], False),
    ([('content-length',',2')], ['0203'], False),
    ([('content-length','2,,2')], ['0203'], False),
    ([('content-length',' 2')], ['0203'], False),
    ([('content-length','2 , 2')], ['0203'], True),
    ([('content-length','2\t,\t2')], ['0203'], True),
    ([('content-length','2'),('content-length','2')], ['0203'], True),
    ([('content-length','2'),('content-length','3')], ['0203'], False),
    ([('content-length','0'),('content-length','00')], [], True),
    ([('content-length','+2')], ['0203'], False),
    ([('content-length','2.0')], ['0203'], False),
    ([('content-length','0x2')], ['0203'], False),
    ([('content-length','2')], ['0203','00'], False),
    ([('content-length','000000000000000000000000000002')], ['0203'], True),
    ([('content-length','003')], ['0203'], False),
]
for extra, chunks, ok in cases:
    f = F(method='POST', path='/l', extra=list(extra))
    st = run1(f, data=list(chunks))['streams'][0]['status']
    exp = 'forwarded' if ok else 'rejected'
    assert st == exp, ('cl', extra, chunks, st, exp)
    st = run1(f, data=list(chunks), trailing=[['x-audit-t','v']])['streams'][0]['status']
    exp = 'forwarded' if ok else 'rejected'
    assert st == exp, ('cl+trailer', extra, chunks, st, exp)
print('ok   content-length matrix')

# huge content-length numeral (never through float, no int overflow)
big = '9' * 5000
f = F(method='POST', path='/l', extra=[('content-length', big)])
assert run1(f, data=['0203'])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected'
print('ok   huge content-length rejected')

# ---- content size limit 65536
f = F(method='POST', path='/b')
assert run1(f, data=['ff' * 32768])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded'
assert run1(f, data=['ff' * 32768, '00'])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected'
assert run1(f, data=['ff' * 32767, 'ff'])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded'
got = run1(f, data=['ff' * 32768])['origins']['r1']
want = b'POST /b HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 65536\r\n\r\n' + b'\xff' * 32768
assert bytes.fromhex(got) == want, 'big body mismatch'
print('ok   content size limits')

# ---- section size limit exactly 8192
def sized(n):
    return F(extra=[('x-p', 'v' * n)])
base = 4 + 1 + 3 + 32 + 4 + 7 + 32 + 11 + 9 + 32 + 5 + 1 + 32
assert base == 175, base
assert run1(sized(8192 - 175))['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded'
assert run1(sized(8191 - 175))['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded'
assert run1(sized(8193 - 175))['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected'
print('ok   section size boundary')

# trailer section size limit
tr = [['x-audit-t', 'v' * (8192 - 32 - 9)]]
assert run1(F(extra=[('te','trailers')]), trailing=tr)['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded'
tr = [['x-audit-t', 'v' * (8192 - 32 - 9 + 1)]]
assert run1(F(extra=[('te','trailers')]), trailing=tr)['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected'
print('ok   trailer section size boundary')

# ---- trailer names
for n, ok in [('x-audit-t', True), ('x-audit-ab', True), ('x-audit-', False),
              ('x-auditt', False), ('x-audit-T', False), ('x-audit-t v', False),
              (':method', False), ('cookie', False), ('x-audit-t.t', True),
              ('x-audit-\xe9', False), ('X-AUDIT-T', False), ('x-audit-t\t', False)]:
    st = run1(F(extra=[('te','trailers')]), trailing=[[n, 'v']])['streams'][0]['status']
    exp = 'forwarded' if ok else 'rejected'
    assert st == exp, ('trailer name', n, st, exp)
print('ok   trailer names')
# empty trailer value allowed
assert run1(F(extra=[('te','trailers')]), trailing=[['x-audit-t','']])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded'
assert run1(F(extra=[('te','trailers')]), trailing=[['x-audit-t',' a']])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected'
print('ok   trailer values')

# ---- route lookup failures
assert run1(F(authority='missing.test'), routes=R)['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected'
assert run1(F(scheme='http', authority='demo.test'), routes=R)['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded'
print('ok   route lookup')

# ---- body preservation with CRLF/NUL/request-like text
body = b'GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: evil\r\n\r\n\x00\xff\n'
hexb = body.hex()
f = F(method='POST', path='/p')
got = run1(f, data=[hexb])['origins']['r1']
want = b'POST /p HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: %d\r\n\r\n' % len(body) + body
assert bytes.fromhex(got) == want
print('ok   body preservation')
